role_overview.summary: Shared Services Canada's CITS Infrastructure Security group is responsible for cybersecurity governance and threat management across the Government of Canada's shared IT infrastructure. Christian served as Senior Business and Technical Architect across two sequential workstreams — implementing Atlassian JIRA for the Cyber Threat Management teams, followed by a SharePoint 2016 solution for the Security Management and Governance teams — both replacing Excel-based ad hoc processes with structured, role-controlled project management platforms. The engagement required deep requirements facilitation with government security and management stakeholders and delivered HA-grade infrastructure for the JIRA environment.

challenge.summary: The client was implementing a SharePoint solution for managing and tracking tasks performed by a number of Security Management and Governance teams. Existing processes relied heavily on Microsoft Excel spreadsheets for reporting, with non-standardized content.
